855.candidate_design: Keep a sorted occupied-seat list. Scan boundary and interior gaps in ascending order, updating only on strictly better distance; binary-position insertion.
855.complexity_target: O(s) time per seat or leave, O(s) space for s occupied seats; O(c^2) worst-case total over c calls.
855.independent_reference: Enumerate every free seat and measure its literal minimum absolute distance to all occupied seats.

863.candidate_design: Iteratively build value-keyed undirected tree adjacency; BFS from official integer target value until distance k.
863.independent_reference: Root-to-node value paths; distance from target computed via longest shared root-path prefix, without graph search.

887.candidate_design: For each move update maximum distinguishable floors per egg count downward, capped at n; stop when coverage reaches n.
887.complexity_target: O(k*m) time and O(k) space for returned optimal moves m.
887.independent_reference: Memoized minimax over every physical drop floor, with broken/surviving subproblem floor counts.

900.candidate_design: Copy encoded runs, maintain run index and consumed count; consume whole exhausted runs and track partial run without expanding.
900.complexity_target: O(r) construction and storage for r encoding entries; O(r+c) total over c next calls.
900.independent_reference: Explicitly expand small encodings into a literal sequence, advance a cumulative consumed index for every call.

901.candidate_design: Monotone decreasing stack of (price, aggregated span); discard all not-greater entries and sum their spans.
901.complexity_target: O(1) amortized per call, O(c) space for c calls.
901.independent_reference: Keep every price and scan backward one day at a time until the first greater price.
